releaseName: Sleeping Guddi v0.3.0 - The Waveform & Studio Update
announcement: Sleeping Guddi v0.3.0 is live! Featuring the all-new Built-in Media Player, interactive Waveform Studio with vinyl turntable animations, 3D card tilt, and interactive road trip memories.
features: Built-in Media Player: Play and scrub your downloaded music & videos directly inside the app with zero external player needed
Waveform Studio & Vinyl Turntable: Real-time soundwave spectrum visualizers, floating Starlight particles, and an animated turntable tonearm that drops the needle when music plays
Interactive 3D Video Cards: Dynamic perspective tilt and specular glare reflections that follow your cursor
Road Trip Photo Gallery: Clickable photo switcher between Solo Sleeping Guddi and The Gang in the Car, complete with floating heart bursts on tap
Instant Seeking & Streaming: Silky-smooth HTTP 206 streaming with zero latency, buffer lag, or position snap-backs
Auto MP3 ID3 Tags & Album Art: Automatically embeds artist, title, album, and high-resolution cover art into downloaded MP3s
Anti-Bot Session Shield: Built-in YouTube cookies manager and visitor token attestation to bypass 403 blocks
